headline: Quick Thinking Saves 18 Students When School Bus Driver Seizes
meta_description: An Eritrean-American man jumped onto a moving school bus in St. Paul and pulled the brake when the driver had a seizure, protecting 18 students.
summary_short: A 27-year-old working nearby in St. Paul spotted a school bus rolling with its doors open and a driver in distress. He jumped aboard and pulled the brake, saving 18 kids.
body:
On a slow Monday afternoon in St. Paul's Dayton's Bluff neighborhood, Ebro Ahmed stepped outside Ya Bricks Snacks and Tobacco just as a Battle Creek Middle School bus rolled past with its doors hanging open. Inside, the driver was having what appeared to be a seizure while the vehicle continued moving. Without hesitation, Ahmed ran toward the bus, jumped through the open doors, and managed to pull the parking brake. He then called police and remained with the driver, keeping him from choking or hitting his head until paramedics arrived. The entire rescue was captured on the store's surveillance camera.

What makes Ahmed's actions remarkable is not just their speed, but his clarity under pressure. He has no medical training, yet he credits watching the medical drama Grey's Anatomy with helping him stay calm—even as adrenaline left him shaking. When asked about the risk he took, his answer was unguarded: "Even if I were to die, it would still be worth it." His singular focus, he explained, was protecting the children on board.

After receiving a $1,000 reward for his heroism, Ahmed deflected praise with characteristic humility. Speaking to CBS News, he said he would prefer not to receive recognition at all. His response reveals something quiet but powerful about his character: he acted not for acclaim or reward, but because eighteen young people needed help, and he was there to give it. On an ordinary Monday in Minnesota, one person's presence of mind and courage turned a potential tragedy into a story of community protection.
quick_facts: 27-year-old Eritrean-American man jumped onto moving bus in St. Paul
Bus carried 18 students from Battle Creek Middle School
Driver was having a seizure when doors were open
Ahmed pulled parking brake and stayed with driver until paramedics arrived
Entire rescue captured on store surveillance camera
